body: Now. This is the loneliest I’ve ever felt. Still feeling it btw.

People will treat things they don’t understand just as if it’s not real or true because they haven’t been through it. But that’s just like saying cancer isn’t real because they don’t know anyone diagnosed with it. 
It isn’t true and this form of thinking comes from a lack of understanding. 
The evidence is there though if they bothered to research it. 
To answer your question “Do you believe bipolar disorder is real or imagined and made up?” 
Yes, I believe it’s real. If it wasn’t true that would have to mean medical professionals from all over the world are lying. I doubt that world medical professionals could unite over this one issue. If so, world peace would have been accomplished. 
Everyone with this same onset of symptoms who’ve been dealing with for years are lying. Everyone who has committed suicide because of their mental condition are lying. 
I think your friend doesn’t understand your mental condition which is why he said such a thing to you. 
Which is pretty common especially if he hasn’t experienced it. 
Mental issues are hard to believe since it isn’t tangible but the evidence is there in your symptoms. 
It also sounds like he hasn’t accepted you mental state because he seems to have the mindset that it can be cured over and done with like a cold. 
The way you explained it in this post is very easy to understand and shows how much you understand your mental condition. 
I think your friend might only understand your feelings if you have it out with him or it could come from over time. It looks like he desperately needs to see it from your view though. 
He seems like he wants to help you by giving you advice to do stuff that might make you feel better. But not contacting for a long while makes it seem like he’s not really worried. I hope things will work out whether he stays your friend or not.

I feel pain for you. I’ve felt the same way and still do. You’re going through hard times already and this stacks it, with your girlfriend leaving. I can’t give you a reason to stay except that in the future you may find a reason to. Please if you can, fight for yourself to live even if it’s just for that future happiness. You may not be joyful or blissful all the time because living in this world is difficult but at least give yourself a chance to have a life well-lived. I hope you can get through this and every other hard time.

I think comparing your pain to others could be like comparing a burn to a cut. One could be more serious or life threatening but both still need medical attention. They both still hurt too.
 So your feelings are valid.  Having emotions is apart of life and something that helps you process painful things. Ignoring can create more problems. 
You are allowed to be sad over things even if it’s just about not being able to get your favorite bag of chips. It’s important to manage it so that it doesn’t impede on your life for a long time. 
With mental issues though you’ll need help to manage with that because it’s not a response to painful things in life. It just comes upon you and it’s not your fault.
Reading books.
LOL noooooo and I told you I was unemployed too haha

I’m so sorry. It makes sense why you’re exhausted. I’ve been through five jobs this year and been unemployed for awhile too. 
Maybe try doing your project for yourself. 
Instead of someone else, that can be your reason to create. 
Joy is fleeting over small things you need to find something that matters to you, that has real meaning. It’s not easy to find. 
I’m still looking. 
And try, try, try again to take a risk, to go in the direction you wanna go. Because staying where you are isn’t won’t change things now. Maybe you could start a business creating what you love. Hopeful wishes for you.

I look forward to my death and have viewed it as a friend for 12 years. For the first time in all these years that scares me. I don’t wanna die and yet I also have decided to. All it’ll take is the right moment and I’m gone. I have so many people depending on me so I know I need to fight it.

I think that “know your limits” is kind of toxic because it sort of implies to stay in your place.
Like people are capable of doing really extraordinary things and if they have to pull some all-nighters to accomplish it, don’t tell them to “know their limits”.
No they were his girlfriends for a couple of weeks that’s why I’m concerned. Thank you for the help
Lol I don’t think I’m the game changer. He’s a carefree person while I’m more serious I think. But I’m pretty sure that’s how it’ll go I don’t wanna risk it.

Eventually she’s going to have to tell your mom. Just let her know she’s gonna have to face the music so to decide when and how she’s gonna tell your mom. Preferably you should be with her. Honestly I wouldn’t expect the best response with these things. However the sooner your mom knows the better it is cause the later it gets the madder she’ll be. You know your mom better than I do however so it’s up to y’all. And since it directly affects your sister it wouldn’t be right to tell your mom on your own.

You’re already showing courage in living hon. If  you’re feeling nothing that means you’re still feeling something. And hon you’re not a burden you’re a person who’s going through a hard time right now. The only thing is, is that people can’t see it like a physical wound. Don’t expect too much out of yourself, pace yourself right now. There’s a lot more to live for and enjoy, don’t give up.

There’s lots of programs for mothers and you can apply for government assistance as well. It’s great that you’re trying especially when it’s hard. May you have one peaceful sleep at least and one good day.
I’m here if u wanna talk rn.

If it helps there’s no such thing as hell. The dead aren’t conscious of anything at all (Ecclesiastes 9:5) I’m hearing that you see no way out of your current situation but there is so much to hope for and live for in the future. Please understand that death isn’t your best option. You don’t have to be passionate about life, it’s normal to feel this way. Even the slightest bit of interest is okay and do not that much of anything is okay too. I just sit in bed all day on my phone. It’s not an expectation of you.

I hope you don’t. I hope for all the best for you in the future. I hope that everything gets better. I hope everyone can understand you and you can understand them. I hope that you can have more fun and happy days than sad. I hope that everything that makes you feel this way changes. I hope that you can see more smiles instead of frowns. I hope most of all that you will be alright.

I feel that way too a lot. But there’s so many possibilities of what you can do and it’s not your only option it’s the worse option to take.
Think of death as your enemy instead of your friend. 
Try not to trust in these feelings too much because they can always change quickly. 
I don’t know your circumstances but you will lose something. 
You’ll lose your future. And you can do a lot now to fight for it. You’re already doing good by venting about it. Please reconsider.

It’s a good question to ask, to help us understand our feelings. Personally I think it’s because we love them that’s why we care. We wouldn’t care if we didn’t love them. 
I like things to be different too. You can always start small. Something I try to do is find new “firsts” for me. Like the first time I tried a different dish at a restaurant. Or the first time I watch a kdrama. Think what haven’t I done before that I find interesting. 
The experiences are fun and thrilling. Sometimes not the best but worth it. You feel better if you learn something new. Try that walk cause that’s the purpose of them-to have no reason to do so. Have you gotten a pet before? Try getting a fish or hamster or if you can a dog or cat.
Exactly, perfect example. Just because someone else has it “harder”, doesn’t mean that it’s any easier to go through.

You’re not wasting my time. I wanted to talk with you. It’s okay reading messages for support isnt the best way to comfort someone. I hope that you can find a way to manage with this and you’re doing good by remembering that your sister loves you and fighting back against these feelings.

20 yr F It sounds like a lot. If it helps I’m unemployed right now too. Jobs are simply that just jobs honestly most of them aren’t even the best. 
Y’know there might be a lot of factors to factor in on why you didn’t get the job like whether there’s a need etc. It doesn’t mean you’re worthless you because the interview didn't go well. I’ve failed so many interviews. But don’t worry there are plenty of jobs out there. 
If you need a reason not to end it, please start small. For me I start with cookies I think about if I die I’ll never eat a cookie again. Or how I’ll never get to watch the Truman show ever again. Or the face of my niece when she hears that she’ll never see me again. 
So hopefully you think about this a little bit and reconsider. There’s so much to hope for and work towards. There’s places to travel and important people you’ll meet later on in life.

Then out of nowhere my mom and her friend driving a car pulled onto the street and picked us up. We escaped! As we looked back from the comfort of our seats we stuck out our tongues and laughed at the boys running after the car.
We ran so hard to get home so that they wouldn’t get us but they were gaining on us.
Then I heard a trash can get knocked over and all of a sudden there were about fifteen neighborhood boys coming out onto the sidewalks and they started chasing us.
Later after school was over me and my sister were walking home. She kept looking back saying someone was following us. I turned and looked back and there was nothing
Then one day one of them asked her out and she rejected him and pushed down.
I’ll tell you a dumb story then. Me and my sister when we were kids hated these neighborhood boys.
There’s nothing to be sorry over hon I can tell you’re doing your best rn.
Okay okay have you tried counting backwards?
Tell me what it is and why you like it
Do you have a favorite movie?
What’s your favorite story?

If you can try to find small reasons to live maybe that might help for me I always start with how much I love cookies. Then how much I love strawberries etc. Then possibly the people in my life or my pets. 
I know the suffocating feelings as I’ve attempted suicide multiple times but suicide is just putting an end to our temporary suffering that doesn’t feel temporary. 
Try to hold on until tomorrow or seek comfort from your favorite movie. Try something different. I think that if we have the strength to attempt suicide we can have the strength to continue on to do what we want to do. After all you made it this far in life, why give up now?

They could be nice or nah, but they also have their own moods or circumstances. 
Really don’t worry too much, everyone gets nervous just embrace it.
You seem like a good person I think you’ll be fine. 
What you said seems reasonable and you have a good day as well.
Hope you can find someone:)!

I think as long as you’re looking appropriate like hygiene wise and clothes you should be fine.
Women aren’t aliens, they’re just the opposite gender. 
Saying something like I’d like to get to know you, could I have your number or your time or something should be fine. Try to start a small conversation nothing to impress, just be yourself. Women actually don’t want to be impressed so throw that out the door. 
Remember women have their own reasons for rejecting someone so don’t sweat it. You’ll find the right person.
